observed_effect.explanation: The apparent paths were passed as rustfmt arguments after Cargo had already discovered crate targets; files outside the fixture lease that needed formatting were rewritten.

impact: An accepted observability source identity and its first public-integration review were invalidated.
A replacement observability binding was invalidated after freeze when races_paths.rs was reformatted again.
No semantic change was attributed to the formatter rewrites, but current evidence had to be reopened and rebound.
root_disposition: Preserved current bytes and never restored old hashes destructively.
Recomputed full current source sets and rebound only after semantic and behavior checks.
Prohibited cargo fmt in concurrent implementation lanes.
Required exact-path rustfmt --edition 2024 with --check for verification and exact leased files only for formatting.
Worker acknowledged the command-boundary correction and stopped unscoped formatting.
orchestration_law: A command whose apparent arguments do not constrain the tool's discovery scope is not a disjoint lease. Root and workers must prove the actual mutation set before using it concurrently.
claim_ceiling: This incident record supports orchestration diagnosis only and does not accept observability, fixture, readiness, release, node closure, or completion.
no_claim_statement: This decision does not claim readiness, release, node closure, or goal completion.
